page.notes: Left margin notes (italic): "nem totius hominis ejusdem habitatio, societas, bonorum multitudo, universalitas, continuitas & æternitas augebunt." Several Greek words and the heavy-printed passages are approximations; the Greek in the text and the faded lines near the lower middle are uncertain. The phrase "LXXIII. Ne-" appears at the foot and is treated as a catchword-like line.
